input_contract: symptom and raw evidence locations
candidate physical-device identity and exact or candidate time window
participating repositories and known artifact information
routes.fallback: If identity, time, or runtime provenance cannot be resolved, preserve the evidence, mark unknown fields, and cap the conclusion at observation_only or candidate_path.

input_contract: feature scope product mode and expected terminal behavior
runtime baseline device identity and exact time window
known producers consumers observations and required scenarios
routes.fallback: If a required edge lacks an observation point, mark it unknown, identify the last positive node and smallest discriminating check, and stop the support claim before that edge.

state owner latch transaction persistence and external side effects
known retry restart replay rollback and failure observations
routes.fallback: If a mandatory replay dimension cannot be executed, mark it unobserved, prohibit a lifecycle pass, and name the smallest safe test required to resolve it.

required repositories modules packages and target device
artifact package deploy and runtime evidence locations
vendor package acquisition hash checksum license platform product family toolchain and project adoption evidence
routes.fallback: If any required module cannot be mapped from commit to runtime-loaded object, mark it unresolved and prohibit an aggregate deployment-correct verdict.

environment device baseline and artifact identity when applicable
test actions observations and evidence locations
output_contract: verdict with allowed and prohibited claims
routes.fallback: If acceptance is ambiguous, preserve partial layer results, mark broader verification blocked, and request only the missing acceptance boundary.

raw fields values units enums schemas and observed behavior
candidate contract class and available narrow skills
routes.fallback: If a narrow skill is unavailable, preserve the classification and boundary evidence, record the missing route, and perform only a bounded contract comparison without inventing the missing procedure.

raw sources capture methods and known clock adjustments
available correlation payload state and sequence fields
routes.fallback: If clocks or raw fields cannot be recovered, preserve per-source order, use logical dependencies only, mark cross-source links candidate, and prohibit timestamp-only causality.

intended bootloader kernel DTB rootfs BSP toolchain and component set
build package deployment slot and runtime-loaded evidence
routes.fallback: If a required identity cannot be bound from source and artifact to the target device and runtime-loaded object, mark it unresolved and prohibit an aggregate runtime-correct verdict.

power bus MIPI media V4L2 ISP and buffer topology
format stride colorspace timestamp ownership error and frame evidence
routes.fallback: If an edge or terminal consumer lacks an observation point, preserve the last positive node, mark later edges unobserved, and name the smallest safe discriminating capture.

input_contract: device software workload and environment baseline
metric budgets units windows sample rules and measurement points
resource thermal power and soak evidence locations
routes.fallback: If the baseline, budget, raw samples, tail distribution, thermal steady state, or soak duration is missing, report the measured subset and keep stability unresolved.

fixed capture controls environment and scene definitions
reference captures objective metrics and subjective observations
routes.fallback: If capture settings, hardware, calibration, tuning, scene, or reference identity drifted, invalidate direct comparison, preserve observations, and request a matched recapture.

source files with preserved relative paths and owner-provided revision context
available parser renderer OCR archive adapter and media-route capability information
routes.fallback: If a file is protected, encrypted, unsupported, corrupt, or only partially extractable, preserve its identity and coverage gap, request an authorized supported export when applicable, and cap analysis before the unreadable region.

input_contract: document identities roles readability and exact claim locations
product variant revision lifecycle status and field scope
raw values units conditions tolerances and available implementation test or field evidence
routes.fallback: If a source region, variant, revision, lifecycle status, measurement condition, or field authority is unknown, preserve the competing atomic facts, classify the comparison unresolved, and prohibit selecting a canonical value.

input_contract: board assembly variant schematic PCB BOM and netlist revision identities
source quality sheet set and exact interface or sequence boundary
connectors nets refdes pins electrical conditions population options and evidence locations
attested native and bridge capabilities plus page tile and visual evidence provenance
routes.fallback: If only partial PDF or OCR evidence exists, record visible labels and components as candidates, keep unproven connectivity and electrical conditions open, and request the smallest correct-revision EDA netlist BOM or explicitly authorized check.

input_contract: exact MCU part package silicon board assembly and document revisions
schematic nets pins AF remap clock reset register SDK IRQ DMA and buffer evidence
vendor SDK toolchain build binary programmer device and runtime identities
safe verification scope and explicit authorization for any active hardware operation
routes.fallback: If part/package/revision, AF/remap, clock/reset, register/IRQ/DMA, build/programmed image, or board runtime evidence is missing, stop at the last proven boundary, keep the peripheral unresolved, and propose the smallest read-only or explicitly authorized discriminator.
